methodology.country_selection: Top 20 covered economies by estimated adults whose main phone is a smartphone. Rank World Bank Global Findex 2024 pop_adult times con9a before rounding. Additional markets provide continuity with adoption.md and messaging.md.
methodology.statcounter: October 2026 is the latest full month at cutoff. Mobile only. Each OS export uses page views observed for that platform. Preserve raw CSV labels. Thresholds sum listed, recognized release categories using rounded published values. Other and nonstandard labels remain unclassified. Classification of Android 12.1 treats it as Android 12L.
methodology.geography: StatCounter geographies apply to the web series. GSMA and World Bank scopes are labeled independently. Country and region codes can overlap (for example SA means the South America regional series here).
methodology.capability: Use matching active handset counts on the same date and geography. A qualified device has a supported OS and an available compatible RCS client and provider path. Activation is a further step. Ordinary feature phones lack the Apple and Google paths.
methodology.capable_share_formula: 100 × P(smartphone among active handsets) × sum over smartphone platforms of [P(platform | smartphone) × P(compatible OS, compatible RCS client and available provider | platform, smartphone)] + 100 × P(non-smartphone among active handsets) × P(compatible RCS path | non-smartphone). Probabilities are fractions. The final term is outside the documented Apple and Google scope.
methodology.confidence: measured covers published telemetry, survey results and sums of those observed categories. vendor-claim covers first-party platform statements and branded disclosures. estimate covers modeled figures, survey extrapolation and ceilings. Null confidence marks missing evidence.
methodology.statcounter_country_coverage: Country and territory version rows use ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 and the StatCounter region selector. Country request codes are uppercase, unlike aggregate region codes. The Findex market ranking and the existing threshold summaries use their separate, original geography selection.
methodology.estimated_phones_by_version: Apply the sampled mobile web platform share and the within-platform version share to the published national smartphone base. This uses web traffic as a proxy for device mix and carries through the base unit and date without extrapolating the base. Unclassified version labels are omitted from estimates. Countries with no verified national smartphone base have no estimates.

requirements.source_title: Turn on RCS messaging on your iPhone
requirements.requirement_text: To use RCS, you need iOS 18 and a cellular plan from a carrier that supports RCS messaging on iPhone.
requirements.note: Base person-to-person requirement. Carrier rollouts can require a later release.

requirements.requirement_text: iOS 18 is compatible with the following iPhone models:
requirements.note: Apple lists iPhone XS, XS Max, XR, and SE (2nd generation or later) among compatible models.
iPhone XS, XS Max and XR remain on the iOS 18 branch. iPhone 11 family and SE (2nd generation) can run the newer branch. Use the iOS 18 floor for basic RCS.

requirements.requirement_text: You must have Android 5.0 or higher for RCS chats to work.
requirements.note: Google’s documented RCS troubleshooting floor. Current app and service support have separate version floors.

requirements.requirement_text: Make sure that Google Messages is your device’s default app for SMS.
requirements.note: Install or update Google Messages from Play, set it as the default Short Message Service (SMS) app, update Google Play services, and use an eligible verified number, data and Google or carrier service. Google recommends the latest app and gives no universal minimum app build for service.

requirements.source_title: Keep your device & apps working with Google Play services
requirements.requirement_text: Google Play services are only supported on devices with Android 7.0 (API level 24) and up.
requirements.note: Google’s supported Play services floor. Devices need a usable Google services setup for the documented Google Messages route.

Third-party metadata for one Google-published package variant, not an official universal policy. The public Play listing was updated November 24 and did not expose a single install floor or minimum RCS app build.

requirements.source_title: Samsung Messages Discontinued | Switch to Google Messages | Samsung US
requirements.requirement_text: Applicable to the US Market Only.
requirements.unit: Android version affected at or above
requirements.note: The US shutdown applies to Galaxy devices running Android 12 or newer. Samsung exempts Android 11 and older from this shutdown. Google documents Samsung Messages as an RCS client where supported. Check model and carrier for other markets.

requirements.requirement_text: The default messaging app on selected Samsung devices
requirements.note: Preload and default vary by model and firmware market. Xiaomi documents Google Messages or Xiaomi Messages as default for different regional variants of the same Redmi model.

requirements.source_title: 华为手机/平板安装了HMS Core，是否可以使用Google应用
requirements.requirement_text: HUAWEI Mate 30 系列及后续机型未预装 GMS/Google应用
requirements.note: Huawei says the Mate 30 series and later covered models ship without Google Mobile Services (GMS) or Google apps. This removes the documented stock Google Messages path. Check any local carrier client separately.

requirements.source_title: 华为手机/平板增强信息开关不显示/开启失败
requirements.requirement_text: 增强信息仅支持设置为默认移动数据的主卡
requirements.note: Mainland-market firmware and service availability vary. Huawei documents devices shipping without Google services. Huawei documents its own RCS service, including SIM and operator provisioning checks. Mainland China also has an operator-backed 5G Messaging initiative. Device and line support, Google Play certification and cross-network interoperability require separate evidence.

requirements.requirement_text: The Google Play Store looks, feels, and operates the same on both Android (Go edition) and Android.
requirements.note: Google documents an Android Go Play Store path. Apply the app and service checks per model and carrier. Motorola documents Android 13 Go and a preloaded Messages experience for moto e13, without establishing RCS for every variant.

requirements.requirement_text: KaiOS is a web-based mobile operating system that enables a new category of smart feature phones.
requirements.note: KaiOS and ordinary feature phones fall outside the documented Apple and Google Messages paths. A feature phone would need a separate compatible client and provider implementation. No verified KaiOS consumer RCS path was found in the vendor documentation.
Jio documents an Android messaging client with RCS. Google’s app and services floors apply to its own route. Treat other implementations independently.
